description: Source code for snapshot and screenshot matchers in Playwright testing framework, including functions for snapshot comparison, screenshot handling, and related utilities.

classes.name: SnapshotHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing snapshot and screenshot comparison, including file paths, comparison logic, and result formatting.

methods.name: toMatchSnapshot
methods.description: Compares a buffer or string against a stored snapshot, updating or creating snapshots based on configuration.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Captures and compares a screenshot of a page or locator against a stored reference, with options for updating or generating snapshots.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshotStepTitle
methods.description: Generates a step title string for screenshot-related test steps.
